title: VIXEN Text CMake requires ambient UNDERTOW_ROOT
body: CMake regeneration fails before target compilation unless UNDERTOW_ROOT is exported; -DUNDERTOW_ROOT does not work because libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt reads ENV{UNDERTOW_ROOT}. The build facade should carry or discover the configured Undertow root instead of requiring a per-shell environment workaround.

title: VIXEN SDI regeneration path depends on caller cwd
body: The documented merge command run from VIXEN failed with exit 127 because it referenced build/wsl/bin/sdi_tool; the actual build output is one directory above and required ../build/wsl/bin/sdi_tool. The SDI workflow should resolve the build tool from the repo/build root or provide a cwd-independent wrapper.

title: VIXEN CMake reconfigure needs cache properties for provisioning switches
body: Passing VIXEN_AUTO_PROVISION_GDB=OFF as an environment variable did not alter the existing CMake cache and reconfigure still attempted debugger provisioning. The facade should preserve or expose documented CMake cache switches consistently across queued reconfigures so callers do not need to diagnose cache-versus-environment semantics.

title: VIXEN app object builds are coupled to a stalled FidelityFX shader generator
body: A queued VixenApp/Object build reached the FidelityFXFsr3ShaderBlobs prerequisite and stalled in the pinned FidelityFX_SC.exe custom commands at 0% CPU; interrupting it produced no app object. The facade should provide a supported cached/prebuilt shader-blob path or a documented narrow compile mode for unrelated application translation units.

title: VIXEN app builds repeatedly regenerate UI SPIR-V without a bounded cache path
body: After a successful CMake configure, every VixenApp build entered ui_shader_spirv_regen and the Python glslc command remained quiet beyond 90 and 120 second bounds; the tracked UiShaderSpirv.g.h was regenerated but the target did not advance. The facade should provide a stable checked-in/generated-header freshness gate or a bounded cached codegen route so unrelated app translation units can build.
